# Coefficients

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
# create first set of fourier coefficients
generate_fourier_coef <- function(nb, sd0 = 2, p=2.5) {
  K <- (nb - 1) / 2
  k <- rep(1:K, each = 2) #coefficient index vector
  sd_k <- sd0 / (k^p) 
  rnorm(2 * K, mean = 0, sd = sd_k)
}
##### SPHERE TO ELLIPSE TRANSFORM METHOD #######
generate_coef_pair <- function(nb, sd0 = 2, d = 1, p = 2.5, seed = NULL) {
  
  if (!is.null(seed)) set.seed(seed)
  
  coef1 <- generate_fourier_coef(nb, sd0, p)
  
  # uniform sphere direction
  z <- rnorm(length(coef1))
  u <- z / sqrt(sum(z^2))  # unit length
  
  # ellipsoid axes (impose similar decay structure)
  axes <- 1 / (1:length(coef1))^p
  
  # scale to ellipse
  dir <- u * axes
  
  # renormalize
  dir <- dir / sqrt(sum(dir^2))
  
  # shift by d
  coef2 <- coef1 + d * dir
  
  list(coef1 = coef1, coef2 = coef2)
}
#### Test Euclidean Distance ####
coefs <- generate_coef_pair(25, d=2)
# sqrt(sum((coefs$coef2 - coefs$coef1)^2))
#### Plot Series Against Each Other ####
coefs <- generate_coef_pair(nb = 25, d = 1)
coef1 <- coefs$coef1
coef2 <- coefs$coef2
fb <- create.fourier.basis(rangeval = c(0, 500), nbasis = 25, period = 500)
Phi <- eval.basis(1:500, fb)[, -1]
x1 <- as.numeric(Phi %*% coef1)
x2 <- as.numeric(Phi %*% coef2)
# plot(x1, type = 'l')
# plot(x2, type = 'l')
# x.state <- (eval.basis(1:n, basisobj = fb)[, -1] %*% fb.coef) |> scale()
x.state <- x1
n <- length(x.state)

# plot
plot(x1, type = 'l', ylim = c(min(x1, x2), max(x1, x2)))
lines(x2, type = 'l', col = 'blue')
```

# Setting window length and High/Low SNR values

```{r}
# smoothing window
window_frac <- 0.05 # proportion of length
window_min  <- 10 
window <- max(window_min, round(window_frac * n))

# target SNR values
lambda_low  <- 0.5  
lambda_high <- 2 

# for function testing
h <- window
s <- 2*window
```

# Function

```{r}
make_noise <- function(x.state, h,
                                ar.coefs, ma.coefs,
                                lambda_target = 1,
                                s = NULL,
                                n_start = 100,
                                name = NULL) {
  n <- length(x.state)
  if (is.null(s)) s <- 2 * h

  # --- Calibration ---

  # Theoretical ACF of the unit-variance ARMA process up to lag s+h-2
  # (need lags up to s+h-2 for the cov_e computation below)
  max_lag  <- s + h - 2
  acf_arma <- ARMAacf(ar = ar.coefs, ma = ma.coefs, lag.max = max_lag)

  # gamma_0 = Var(X_t) when innovation variance = 1.
  # ARMAacf returns the normalised ACF (rho_k); must scale by gamma_0 to get
  # autocovariance gamma_k = gamma_0 * rho_k.
  if (length(ar.coefs) == 0 && length(ma.coefs) == 0) {
    gamma0_unit <- 1
  } else {
    psi         <- ARMAtoMA(ar = ar.coefs, ma = ma.coefs, lag.max = 200)
    gamma0_unit <- sum(c(1, psi)^2)
  }
  gamma_unit <- gamma0_unit * acf_arma

  # Autocovariance of the MA_h-smoothed unit process at lag k:
  #   cov_e(k) = (1/h^2) * sum_{d=-(h-1)}^{h-1} (h-|d|) * gamma_unit(|k+d|)
  d_vals <- seq(-(h - 1), h - 1)
  w_d    <- h - abs(d_vals)
  cov_e  <- sapply(0:(s - 1), function(k) {
    sum(w_d * gamma_unit[abs(k + d_vals) + 1]) / h^2
  })

  # Expected value of roll_var(e_smooth, s) per unit innovation variance.
  # roll_var subtracts the local window mean, which absorbs variance for
  # autocorrelated processes -- var_smooth_eff corrects for this bias.
  k_seq             <- 1:(s - 1)
  var_window_mean_e <- (s * cov_e[1] + 2 * sum((s - k_seq) * cov_e[k_seq + 1])) / s^2
  var_smooth_eff    <- (s / (s - 1)) * (cov_e[1] - var_window_mean_e)

  # Empirical variance of the h-smoothed signal (SNR numerator)
  x_smooth <- roll_mean(x.state, width = h, min_obs = h)
  var_x_smooth <- mean(roll_var(x_smooth, width = s, center = TRUE, min_obs = s),
                       na.rm = TRUE)

  # Scale innovation SD so that E[roll_var(smooth noise)] / var_x_smooth = 1/lambda_target
  sigma2 <- var_x_smooth / (lambda_target * var_smooth_eff)
  sigma  <- sqrt(sigma2)

  # --- Simulation ---

  noise <- arima.sim(
    model = list(order = c(length(ar.coefs), 0, length(ma.coefs)),
                 ar = ar.coefs, ma = ma.coefs),
    n = n,
    rand.gen = function(t) rnorm(t, mean = 0, sd = sigma),
    n.start = n_start)

  y <- x.state + noise

  # --- SNR check ---

  # Smooth both signal and noise with the same h-point moving average
  x_smooth_chk <- roll_mean(x.state, width = h, min_obs = h)
  e_smooth     <- roll_mean(noise,   width = h, min_obs = h)

  # Local variance of each over window s; require full windows to avoid edge artifacts
  lv_signal <- roll_var(x_smooth_chk, width = s, center = TRUE, min_obs = s)
  lv_noise  <- roll_var(e_smooth,     width = s, center = TRUE, min_obs = s)

  # Clip to interior where both rolling ops have full windows
  interior <- (h + floor(s / 2)):(n - floor(s / 2))
  ok <- !is.na(lv_signal[interior]) & !is.na(lv_noise[interior]) & lv_noise[interior] > 1e-5
  snr_local <- lv_signal[interior][ok] / lv_noise[interior][ok]
  
  # Check whether simulated noise achieved its theoretical smooth variance.
  # noise_var_ratio should be ~1; mean SNR (ratio of means) is the calibration
  # target -- median is pulled down by flat signal regions and is not reliable.
  noise_var_ratio <- mean(lv_noise[interior], na.rm = TRUE) / (sigma2 * var_smooth_eff)
  mean_snr        <- mean(lv_signal[interior][ok]) / mean(lv_noise[interior][ok])
  
  # Print diagnostic check
  cat(sprintf(
    "[%s] SNR target: %.2f | mean: %.2f (%+.1f%%) | noise var ratio (emp/theo): %.3f | n: %d\n",
    name, lambda_target,
    mean_snr, 100 * (mean_snr - lambda_target) / lambda_target,
    noise_var_ratio,
    length(snr_local)
  ))
  
  # --- Plots ---

  plot(0:(h - 1), acf_arma[1:h], type = "h",
       main = paste0(name, " ACF"), xlab = "Lag", ylab = "ACF")
  abline(h = 0)

  plot(y, type = "l",
       main = paste0(name, " | lambda = ", lambda_target),
       xlab = "t", ylab = "value")
  lines(x.state, col = 'blue')

  # --- Outputs ---

  list(
    name          = name,
    lambda_target = lambda_target,
    ar            = ar.coefs,
    ma            = ma.coefs,
    sigma           = sigma,
    sigma2          = sigma2,
    acf_arma        = acf_arma[1:h],
    var_smooth_unit = cov_e[1],
    var_smooth_eff  = var_smooth_eff,
    noise         = noise,
    x             = x.state,
    y             = y,
    noise_var_ratio = noise_var_ratio,
    snr_local       = snr_local,
    lv_signal     = lv_signal,
    lv_noise      = lv_noise
  )
}
```

# MA 1

```{r}
ar.coefs <- numeric(0)
ma.coefs <- c(0.3)

ma1_low <- simulate_arma_noise(
  x.state = x.state,
  h = window,
  ar.coefs = ar.coefs, ma.coefs = ma.coefs,
  lambda_target = lambda_low,
  name = "MA1 | low"
)
ma1_high <- simulate_arma_noise(
  x.state = x.state,
  h = window,
  ar.coefs = ar.coefs, ma.coefs = ma.coefs,
  lambda_target = lambda_high,
  name = "MA1 | high"
)
```

# ARMA 21

```{r}
ar.coefs <- c(0.8, 0.1)

arma21_low <- make_noise(
  x.state = x.state,
  h = window,
  ar.coefs = ar.coefs, 
  ma.coefs = ma.coefs,

)

arma21_high <- make_noise(
  x.state = x.state,
  h = window,
  ar.coefs = ar.coefs, ma.coefs = ma.coefs,

)
```
